    Accessibility, privacy & open-source technology

    Designed toward WCAG 2.2 AAA: high-contrast text, visible keyboard focus, large controls, reduced-motion support, semantic labels and status announcements. Full AAA conformance has not been independently audited. OCR may contain errors, especially with complex layouts or handwriting. This version recognises English text.

    Leafword uses Tesseract.js / Tesseract (Apache-2.0), PDF.js (Apache-2.0), and docx (MIT). All libraries and English language data are hosted with this app. No document content is sent over the network; no browser storage APIs or service workers are used. Website hosting can still receive standard page and asset requests. Downloaded files are managed by your browser and operating system.
